name: smwgraphics-metroid-zero-mission-norfair-overgrown-vegetation-area
title: Metroid: Zero Mission - Norfair (Overgrown Vegetation Area)
description:
This is the FG version of the overgrown vegetation area of Norfair. This would have fit well with the BG. I believe ExGFX Revolution can fix this, but now, it's time for the FG to be released. Besides the normal palette, it also comes with the normal plant cave palette seen in Metroid Desolation.
With that said, Happy New Year to all SMWC members.
No credit needed.
